beginner.summary: For analysts, developers and data engineers who know SQL and are new to Amazon Redshift. Covers the leader node, compute nodes and slices, provisioned RA3 clusters and Redshift Serverless, connecting with Query Editor v2, drivers and the Data API, data types, compression encodings, distribution and sort keys, COPY and UNLOAD with S3, analytic SQL, MERGE upserts, views and materialized views, roles and grants, query monitoring, VACUUM and ANALYZE, snapshots, cost controls, and a retail warehouse capstone.
prerequisites: Writes SQL joins, aggregates and subqueries against a relational database
Has an AWS account or sandbox with rights to create IAM roles, S3 buckets and Redshift resources
Uses the AWS CLI v2 or CloudShell and a text editor to run commands and edit SQL files
outcomes: Create provisioned RA3 and Serverless Redshift warehouses and connect with several clients
Design tables with appropriate data types, encodings, distribution styles and sort keys and prove the effect with EXPLAIN and system views
Load and export data with COPY and UNLOAD, diagnose load errors and keep tables healthy with VACUUM and ANALYZE
Secure access with roles and grants, recover data from snapshots and control cost with pause, resume and usage limits
